data.heading: Where it started
data.description: Audio quality issues affecting 5 to 7% of customer service calls, with no reliable way to catch or trace them.

blocks.title: Business problem
blocks.body: Each recorded call was evaluated manually and given one overall rating based on the audio issues observed. Evaluating that many call files by hand was cumbersome and time-consuming, and support agents needed real-time help to reduce resolution time.

blocks.title: Technical barriers
blocks.body: Existing tools used RMSE and spectrograms to visualize and analyze signals, so echo, lag, low volume, and background noise went unrecognized. Issues were never captured or scored by type, root cause analysis and proactive monitoring of problem calls were missing, and call quality was never tracked at regular intervals by geography, carrier, time of day, or day of week.

blocks.title: Agivant's role
blocks.body: Deep learning model development, audio processing pipeline engineering, scoring framework design, and call insights dashboards

data.heading: What Agivant built
data.description: Agivant built and implemented a complete audio quality solution on Vertex AI. Call recordings are copied from storage into a Dataflow pipeline, split into 30-second segments, and scored segment by segment through model inference. Speaker diarization distinguishes and labels each speaker, a weighted scoring framework combines attribute scores into one call score, and results land in BigQuery for dashboards and anomaly detection. Value in days and weeks.

blocks.title: Multi-attribute quality scoring
blocks.body: Deep learning models measure multiple audio quality attributes on two-way calls, detecting echo, lag, low volume, and noise.

blocks.title: Speaker diarization
blocks.body: Distinguishes and labels each speaker in the recording, segmenting the content by speaker so the source of an issue during a call is clear.

blocks.title: Weighted scoring framework
blocks.body: Combines attribute scores into one customized, weighted quality score per call.

blocks.title: Call insights dashboards
blocks.body: Maps regular performance, with quality distribution by geography, carrier, and other call metadata, and highlights anomalies.

blocks.title: Anomaly detection
blocks.body: Quantitative measures and statistical analysis flag deviations from normal patterns, such as abnormal CSAT scores or average handling time alerts.

blocks.title: Parallel processing pipeline
blocks.body: Dataflow processes call files in large-scale parallel runs, with copies purged after processing and accessible only to the pipeline.

blocks.title: Audio scoring outputs
blocks.body: Each call produces an audio scoring summary and segment-level details, read through the BigQuery Storage Read API.

blocks.title: ML lifecycle on Vertex AI
blocks.body: Model training, deployment, registry, serving, and monitoring all run on Vertex AI.

blocks.title: Before
blocks.body: Manual call-by-call review, one overall rating, echo and lag unrecognized, and no pattern tracking.

blocks.title: After
blocks.body: Every call segmented, scored per attribute and per speaker, rolled into a weighted score, and mapped by geography and carrier.

data.heading: Proof in production
data.description: A call recording is copied into the Dataflow pipeline and split into 30-second segments. Vertex AI predicts quality on each segment, diarization shows who was speaking when the issue occurred, and the scores land in BigQuery. Dashboards map quality by geography and carrier, anomaly detection flags unusual CSAT or handling time patterns, and the copy is purged once processing finishes.

blocks.heading: Measured results
blocks.description: Call quality issues are now identified automatically and traced to their source, with fewer agent hours per call.

blocks.title: Challenges overcome
blocks.body: Recognizing issues that signal-level tools missed, classifying quality across 32 audio metadata attributes in high-dimensional space, and processing call files at scale while keeping them accessible only to the pipeline.
